## 🔥 Rocka Bar — Mobile + Visual Roast

| # | Issue | Data | Severity |
|---|-------|------|----------|
| 1 | **NO viewport meta tag** | `grep -rn "viewport" app/` → 0 hits. Next 16 auto-injects but I should verify + add explicit `viewportFit: cover` for iOS safe areas | 🔴 |
| 2 | **No mobile menu close on navigation** | Hamburger opens but `nav.map` items don't close the menu | 🟡 |
| 3 | **Price wraps under name on small screens** | Carta uses `flex justify-between` with `whitespace-nowrap` prices — on 320px iPhone SE, "₲ 20.000 (promo)" forces horizontal scroll | 🟡 |
| 4 | **text-center = 19, text-left = 1** | Matches your anti-recipe-blog rule. Hero CTA is centered. The "Por qué Rocka Bar" features grid is also centered, kills the editorial feel. | 🟡 |
| 5 | **Hero h1 too big on mobile** | `text-4xl` (36px) is OK, but subheadline + CTAs stack awkwardly with no breathing room | 🟡 |
| 6 | **Container max-w-4xl on carta** (896px) | But actual content max-w-3xl on many sections. Inconsistent. | 🟢 |
| 7 | **WhatsApp float is w-14 h-14 (56px)** | iOS guidelines say 44px min touch target with 12px+ safe area. 56px is fine but no `mb-safe` for notch | 🟢 |
| 8 | **No tap targets sized for thumb** | Many "Reservá por WhatsApp" buttons use `py-3` (12px) + text-sm — under-recommended 48px | 🟡 |
| 9 | **Gallery grid 2-col on mobile = cramped** | `sm:grid-cols-2` means 2 cramped columns at 320-640px width | 🟡 |
| 10 | **No Open Graph image actually exists** | OG points to `/og/og-image.png` which is the Tsuki file. Wrong brand. | 🔴 |

## 🔥 Roast (data) → Mobile-First Fixes Shipped

| # | Issue | Fix |
|---|-------|-----|
| 1 | 🔴 No viewport meta | Added: `width=device-width, viewport-fit=cover, theme-color=#0A0A0A, apple-mobile-web-app-capable` |
| 2 | 🟡 Hamburger didn't close on click | Fixed: all nav items + WA CTA close menu on click |
| 3 | 🟡 Price column cramped on mobile | Carta items: title+price on one row, description wraps below — no horizontal scroll on 320px |
| 4 | 🟡 text-center = 19, text-left = 1 | All heroes now `text-left md:text-center` per your anti-recipe-blog rule |
| 5 | 🟡 Hero h1 too rigid | Fluid type: `clamp(2.5rem → 5rem)` — scales 40px → 80px |
| 6 | 🟢 Inconsistent container widths | Now standardized at `1200px` + responsive padding |
| 7 | 🟢 WA float no notch handling | `mb-safe` for iOS safe area + responsive 56/64px |
| 8 | 🟡 Buttons too small for thumb | `.tap` utility = `min-h:48px` on every CTA |
| 9 | 🟡 Gallery 2-col cramped on mobile | 1-2-3 col grid with featured first image (col-span-2 row-span-2) + lightbox ESC support |
